source_age_type: parcel-assessor YearBuilt1 associated with building outline; not validation of actual construction year and not BRAILS predictions
area_weighting: sum of distinct clipped outline areas; compare with LARIAC union overlap audit; no inferred floor area
unobserved_age_sensitivity: lower=observed pre1970/total area; upper=(observed pre1970+missing-age area)/total; not point imputations
qa_recovery: Original extraction completed all linkage records and tract CSVs, then failed while hashing a shadowed path variable. QA reconstructed from retained outputs; no physical stages rerun.
